description: Spot token balances for one Hyperliquid wallet address -- per token: total, amount on hold in open orders, available (total minus hold) and entry notional in USDC. Includes the spot USDC balance. Public on-chain data, keyless. Use for "what tokens does this Hyperliquid wallet hold". e.g. {address:"0x31dea2516beee92135b96f464eeec3cf292a13f2"}.

limit.description: Max token rows to return, largest first (default 50). Totals always cover every token.
